item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.34 (52)
- New: the Shelf, formerly Screen Shelf, holds files, images and pasted text as well as screenshots. Drag or paste them in, or use "Add to Shelf" in Image Tools and "Add Frame to Shelf" in Quick Video. - New: Shelf Sync shows your Shelf on your other Macs, through Xintech's cloud storage, with your Xin account and a linked license. You choose what syncs: everything, nothing or each item. Synced items are kept for a limited time, and screenshots added automatically sync only if you turn that on. - Shelf: opens at the size of its items, zooms on a title-bar double-click, takes part in window tiling, and comes forward without bringing Pro's other windows with it. Screen Tools Settings opens above a floating Shelf. - Screen Tools: a capture no longer hides XHelpers Pro's own windows, so you can capture the Shelf, pins, Image Tools or the player. - Text Editor, Markdown Preview, File Viewer, Image Tools and PDF Tools have a File menu in the menu bar, with Copy File Name, Copy File Path and Show in Finder. - Dictation: GPT-6 Luna's After text is what goes in; none of its changes is held back as a suggestion. - Dictation: GPT-6 Luna's Polish stays within what you said and no longer swaps in text from the window you are dictating into. - Dictation: "Insert at the current cursor" inserts into the field that has the keyboard, in Chromium-based apps too. - Dictation: when secure input stops a recording, the floating panel says so clearly. - Dictation: GPT-6 Luna's card keeps its place when you dictate more words into the Review panel. - AI Usage: the menu bar shows first the accounts your Codex and Claude Code command-line tools use by default. - Auto Blackout: a built-in display you dimmed to zero yourself is no longer brightened again a minute later.
